correctness.rationale: The unique radical-coefficient representation is exhausted by zero, one, two or three nonzero linear coefficients. When one coefficient is nonzero, the unit reduction f=xu+v -> x+v/u and square-zero-variable automorphisms reduce to x+delta yz, x+y, or x+y+z. Explicit power ranks (4,0,0)/(4,1,0); (4,2,0); (5,2,0)/(5,2,1) determine the partitions. The zero-linear cases have ranks 0, 1 or 2. Polynomial multiplicities sum to q^7. The executable checker fully matches the stated distribution for q=3 and 5 and checks limited further cases; infinite correctness uses the proof, not experiments.

value.rationale: The full rank/Jordan distribution for the first three-axis squarefree Artinian complete intersection is a natural exact finite-field invariant. It counts all nonhomogeneous radical elements rather than just generic linear ones; the isolated x+delta yz stratum changes Jordan type for a fraction 1-1/q of one-supported linear elements, and the characteristic-three vs at-least-five generic partition transition is quantified with exact multiplicities. The complete small-case classification has standalone value as a boundary for Lefschetz/Jordan-type studies.
